description: A custom LinearLayout subclass that manages a stream of card views with swipe-to-dismiss functionality, animations, and hierarchical change handling.

classes.name: CardStreamLinearLayout
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that manages a stream of swipe-dismissable card views with animations and hierarchical change handling.

classes.name: OnDissmissListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to dismiss events of cards.

classes.name: EndAnimationWrapper
classes.description: Abstract class implementing Animator.AnimatorListener with empty method bodies for convenience.

methods.name: addCard
methods.description: Adds a card view with a dismissible flag.

methods.name: addView
methods.description: Overrides addView to initialize cards before adding.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Handles layout changes, sets up animations, and scrolls to first visible card if needed.

methods.name: isSwiping
methods.description: Determines if a movement exceeds the touch slop threshold to qualify as a swipe.

methods.name: swipeView
methods.description: Moves and rotates a view based on swipe delta.

methods.name: notifyOnDismissEvent
methods.description: Calls the dismiss listener with the tag of the dismissed card.

methods.name: getFirstVisibleCardTag
methods.description: Returns the tag of the first visible child view.

methods.name: setFirstVisibleCard
methods.description: Sets the first visible card by tag, scrolling if layouted.

methods.name: triggerShowInitialAnimation
methods.description: Flags to run initial animations after layout.

methods.name: setCardStreamAnimator
methods.description: Sets the animator object for card animations.

methods.name: setOnDismissListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for dismiss events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes animator and touch configuration based on attributes.

methods.name: initCard
methods.description: Initializes a card view, resets its state, and sets touch listener.

methods.name: isFixedView
methods.description: Checks if a view is fixed (not dismissible).

methods.name: resetAnimatedView
methods.description: Resets view properties to default state.

methods.name: runInitialAnimations
methods.description: Runs initial entrance animations for all child views.

methods.name: runShowActionAreaAnimation
methods.description: Animates the action area of a card into view.

methods.name: handleViewSwipingOut
methods.description: Animates and removes a view when swiped out.

methods.name: handleViewSwipingIn
methods.description: Animates a view back into place if swipe is canceled.

methods.name: scrollToCard
methods.description: Scrolls the parent ScrollView to the card with the specified tag.
